description:
XBU40 Enclave Platform



XBU40 Enclave Platform-as-a-Service     is InfusionPoints’ secure cloud platform designed to support organizations pursuing and maintaining FedRAMP 20x authorization. Built on AWS GovCloud, it delivers a secure-by-design environment with automated compliance
 validation, continuous monitoring, and authorization readiness. The platform is operated through Command Center and powered by AuditShield for automated evidence validation and KSI monitoring.


Platform Management – Command Center


Command Center is the platform management interface used to operate and monitor XBU40 Enclave environments. It provides centralized visibility into infrastructure security, vulnerability posture, Key Security Indicators
 (KSIs), and compliance evidence. Through Command Center, organizations maintain a real-time view of operational and compliance status across their environment.


Core Service Capabilities


XBU40 Enclave Platform combines secure infrastructure with integrated compliance automation to support
FedRAMP 20x authorization and continuous monitoring. The service includes secure hosting in AWS GovCloud, platform management through Command Center, vulnerability lifecycle management, and automated KSI validation
 through AuditShield. These capabilities allow organizations to maintain continuous authorization readiness.


Secure Hosting Environment


XBU40 provides a secure-by-design hosting architecture engineered to support FedRAMP 20x Moderate environments. The platform includes identity and access controls, network protection, encryption, and centralized logging
 aligned with government cloud security practices. Environments are supported by InfusionPoints Cloud Operations and Security Operations teams.


Vulnerability and Exposure Management

XBU40 provides continuous vulnerability scanning, prioritization, and remediation tracking across hosted environments. Findings are managed through integrated workflows that support remediation and validation. This ensures systems maintain a
continuously monitored vulnerability posture aligned with FedRAMP 20x KSIs.


Trust Center


The Trust Center provides a centralized view of system compliance posture and Key Security Indicators. It allows stakeholders to access evidence artifacts, compliance documentation, and monitoring dashboards in real time. This transparency enables assessors
 and agencies to validate security posture through live operational evidence.


AuditShield – Automated Evidence and KSI Validation


AuditShield is the automation engine within the XBU40 Enclave Platform that continuously validates compliance posture. It collects and verifies evidence through APIs, serverless validation functions, and infrastructure
 telemetry. Each validation maps directly to a 
FedRAMP 20x KSI, preserving artifacts and timestamps for assessor review.



Continuous Authorization Monitoring


XBU40 supports continuous authorization readiness through automated monitoring and validation of system security posture. The platform evaluates infrastructure configuration, vulnerability lifecycle status, security telemetry, and KSI validation results. All
 evidence and compliance artifacts are maintained within Command Center to ensure environments remain
continuously audit-ready.

description:
Constellation GovCloud (CGC) is an information system that provides the necessary Platform as a Service (PaaS) architecture layers to support Merlin-operated Software as a Service (SaaS) applications. These Merlin SaaS applications will be hosted and provided to U.S. federal agencies, including local and state governments and tribal organizations. The CGC is part of a managed service that is designed to accelerate FedRAMP authorizations allowing Merlin SaaS companies to achieve a FedRAMP Authority to Operate (ATO) more quickly and cost-effectively.

**Services undergoing approval for use — not authorized.** The following services are hosted on CGC but are **not** authorized services and are **not** included in this certification. They are undergoing approval for use and are recorded here for transparency only; none is covered by this package, and each moves into the certified service list only on completion of that approval.

- **Torq AI SOC Platform** — Torq combines agentic insights and automation so that federal agencies and public sector organizations can triage, investigate, and respond to actual risks, faster. Torq streamlines every step from alert through resolution, expanding capacity and throughput. First, Torq ingests and normalizes telemetry from across your security stack, preparing the data for agentic reasoning at scale. Auto Triage filters out noise and prioritizes actual threats. Next, cases are automatically opened and assigned to highly specialized AI agents designed for investigation and response. Using tools and actions you specify, they gather evidence, assemble timelines, and transparently record decisions and authorized actions. Your team is in complete control. With Torq, your SOC delivers more results, more efficiently, from triage through remediation.

- **QIZ** — QIZ delivers a cloud-based cryptography posture management platform for government agencies and regulated organizations to manage cryptographic risk. The system provides centralized capabilities for cryptographic discovery and inventory, correlation of findings to affected systems and owners, policy definition, risk-based triage, root cause analysis, and remediation planning. QIZ collects cryptographic data from network traffic, system and application configurations, source code, binaries, and cloud infrastructure. Cryptographic standards are defined within the platform, and the system evaluates the environment against those standards to report current posture and identify policy violations. QIZ produces a contextualized cryptographic bill of materials (CBOM), exportable in standard formats, and a policy driven transition plan prioritized by risk and business context, giving agencies a sequenced and repeatable path toward post-quantum readiness.

- **Veeam** — Veeam Data Cloud Gov for Microsoft 365 is a fully managed Software as a Service (SaaS) backup solution for federal, state, and local government agencies that need to protect and recover their Microsoft 365 data. The service runs on Microsoft Azure within Constellation GovCloud's boundary and backs up Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive. Backups stay immutable, so they cannot be altered or deleted, even from a compromised administrator account. Agencies sign in through their own identity provider and use role-based access control to decide who can manage and restore data. When ransomware, a compromised account, or a large-scale data loss strikes, agencies can quickly restore what they need and limit disruption to mission-critical services. Built on a native integration with Microsoft 365 Backup Storage, the service enables fast initial backup with no API throttling, delivering restore performance at speeds exceeding 1TB per hour. There is no infrastructure for agencies to manage, and storage is included with per-user licensing.

functions_claimed.evidence: The CGC is part of a managed service that is designed to accelerate FedRAMP authorizations allowing Merlin SaaS companies to achieve a FedRAMP Authority to Operate (ATO) more quickly and cost-effectively.

description:
Halo is a multi-tenant cloud platform that provides a unified operating environment for service management, workflow automation, reporting, and compliance operations. The platform is designed to support organizations in managing operational processes, security workflows, and regulated service delivery from a single, integrated system.

For Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), Halo supports FedRAMP, CMMC, and DoD compliance programs by enabling compliance activities to be managed as part of day-to-day operations rather than as a separate workstream. Halo's GRC module provides functionality for vulnerability and risk management, Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) tracking, asset inventory, deviation management, OSCAL-based system documentation, and cross-framework control mapping. It also supports continuous monitoring packages, Key Security Indicator validation, and Ongoing Authorization deliverables in both human-readable and machine-readable formats.

In addition to GRC, the Halo platform supports broader enterprise service management capabilities, including IT Service Management (ITSM), Enterprise Service Management (ESM), Configuration Management (CMDB), and Service Level Management (SLM). These include core ITIL practices such as change management, incident management, user access management, self-service portals, automated task assignment and escalation, SLA tracking, and executive dashboards.

description:
Kovr AI is a patented AI-native cyber compliance automation platform purpose-built for organizations navigating the most demanding federal and commercial cybersecurity frameworks including FedRAMP, Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC 2.0), NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, DoD Security Requirements Guide (SRG), FISMA, DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, and more. Designed to replace the manual, document-heavy workflows that have historically made federal authorization a multi-year, multi-million-dollar undertaking, Kovr compresses the path from readiness to Authorization to Operate (ATO) by automating the most labor-intensive phases of the compliance lifecycle.
 
Kovr's AI-powered engine empowers users with evidence processing, control analysis, and artifact generation including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), and Security Requirements Traceability Matrices (SRTMs) directly from system documentation inputs reducing artifact preparation time from weeks to days. The platform natively supports NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 and 800-171 control baselines, OSCAL-format exports, and continuous controls monitoring (CCM), enabling organizations to maintain their authorization posture between assessment cycles and satisfy evolving continuous monitoring requirements across FedRAMP Rev 5, CMMC, and DoD SRG frameworks.
 
Artemis, Kovr's secure AI enclave, allows ISSOs, compliance officers, and security teams to generate control implementation narratives, draft assessment responses, and accelerate evidence collection without exposing sensitive system data to external AI services. Pre-built connectors and automated evidence ingestion eliminate manual artifact management, while integrated POA&M lifecycle tracking provides real-time visibility into remediation status.

description:
Workiva provides connected reporting and compliance through its intuitive cloud platform that modernizes how people work within thousands of commercial organizations and hundreds of federal, state, and local government agencies.

Workiva’s platform is built upon a data management engine, offering controlled collaboration, data integration, granular permissions and a full audit trail. Workiva helps mitigate risk, improves productivity and gives users confidence in their data-driven decisions.
Complex reports made easy— our customers create and connect data and narrative to consolidate and publish financial, performance, and regulatory reports. We provide confidence in the numbers and enable pride in the delivery.

Compliance made simple— streamline documentation, testing, and reporting in a connected environment. Manage risk assessments, evidence requests, issues, and findings with real-time reports and dashboards.

Connect your documents and data at enterprise scale in a collaborative work management platform. Import documents, sync with Excel®, or connect Workiva to a variety of agency information systems. Workiva is built for the way government agencies work.
Trust your data from beginning to end. Workiva can be used across interdependent agency teams and departments to create a single source of truth for mission-critical processes.
